Figure 1:An Illustrative Roadmap to AGI and its Beyond.As AI development progresses, broad capability resembles a summit that systems approach but may hit diminishing returns due to constraints in data, compute, and parameters.
In Era 1 (2012–2020) progress came mainly from scaling model capacity, and in Era 2 (2020–2025) from scaling data and computation.
For Era 3 (2026+), this work emphasizes a next-scaling lens: co-designing a cost-effective System-1 that prioritizes interactions by expected utility and a resource-intensive System-2 for complicated tasks.
This emphasis becomes increasingly consequential for foundation models and embodied agents as they depend on generation, computation, tool use, and environmental interaction, and thus on the cost of each.

Figure 2:The Super Parrot Hypothesis.An illustrative, hypothesized trajectory rather than an established chronology: a conceptual progression of AI from imitation-based language learning (2020–2022), through interpretable reasoning enabled by chain-of-thought (CoT) and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) (2022–2025), to a hypothesized future (2026+) of self-coded representations and self-evolution that may exceed human interpretability. As AI increasingly produces the data and feedback it learns from (AI for AI), deciding which self-generated interactions are worth executing becomes a central efficiency problem.
